description: Na₃Zr₂Si₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.72 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.82 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.22 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-38°. There is one shorter (1.64 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-41°. There are three shorter (1.64 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-39°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃ZrSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom.
